harness: probe service (tools/stallfloor/probe.py): frozen kernel families, every thread of every launch judged against a host-computed checksum
what: a fixed-latency producer in front of ONE operand register of a tensor word (kind raw with a tensor consumer; uniform fragments; the tested register is dirtied 30 cycles in front of the producer): the accumulator quad of QMMA.SF.16832.F32.E4M3.E2M1.E8 behind a 64-bit CS2R (both result registers) and behind MOV, the accumulator of HMMA.16816.F32.BF16 behind FMUL.FTZ, the B pair behind the immediate-mask LOP3.LUT, and the uniform operand behind UMOV (read relatively: the tensor word's result against the same word's 45 cycles later); every class with its positive control (the producer's word behind the consumer: it must be wrong)

conditions.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

provenance.dep_table_commit: c8d79a6 The sm_120 dependency table prices the upper register of an IMAD.WIDE result apart, and CS2R -> IMAD is 6: two p

classes.good: the intended values in all 256 iterations
classes.stale: raw / ord: the consumer took the register's previous content in all 256
classes.late: war: the store took the rewritten register in all 256
classes.overtake: war: the read-back saw the slot before the store in all 256
